verdict.rationale: Gram documents a platform MCP server that lets an org admin operate the product (find/add servers, manage risk policies, author skills, read observability) entirely from within an MCP client like Claude Code or Cursor using natural language, without opening the dashboard — this is direct agentic/NL control of the product itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these natural-language admin operations actually execute correctly (only the CLI binary itself was runtime-probed, not the platform-mcp NL workflow).
